interpretation.time: navigation/click to asserted usable UI; no automation think time; two samples per named phase
interpretation.bytes: browser ResourceTiming.transferSize, includes response headers; cache hits transfer 0; excludes TLS framing
interpretation.renderer_metric_note: TaskDuration is a diagnostic renderer counter; only cold fresh-context entry values are compared as rendering work. Other phase counters are retained without a per-phase CPU claim.
interpretation.hardware: service cgroup CPU deltas at 500 ms, overlap-interpolated for phase window including 700 ms settling; memory peak at observed samples; browser sum of process RSS double-counts shared pages
interpretation.scope: bounded local access measurements; no production concurrency, p95/p99 or server capacity claim; not formal CI evidence
